remaining_review_notes: Records 16–17 select the electronic/database branch of Requirements §§4.b–4.c. The paper-only TOC/page-number/display obligations are not independently emitted. This is acceptable only if the audit explicitly limits F1 to a database/export product; it is not a complete extraction for a paginated SSS.

Records 19 and 98 cite only the introductory sentence but normalize the following subordinate headings. The full relevant pages were inspected; adding heading excerpts would improve record-self-contained provenance.
Record 61 says shall avoid imposing requirements. For a crisper prohibition, shall not impose requirements is preferable and preserves source force.

Several compound metadata sets (identity, reference metadata, hardware characteristics) remain combined under one identify/include predicate. No independent obligations were found omitted by those groupings, but stricter field-level atomization could split them without adding requirements.

The detailed sublists in §3.3.x.c–g are introduced with such as. They are illustrative characteristics, not individually mandatory fields; preserving the top-level inclusion and applicability conditions avoids inventing requirements.
